decisions.title: Frozen-file list - explicit operator approval required to modify
decisions.summary: The following files are frozen and require explicit user approval per modification: main.py, core/log_setup.py, core/moon_proxy.py, lcu/lcu_client.py, core/game_snapshot.py, ops/rc_dev_runtime.py, ops/rc_supervisor.py, app/__init__.py, app/_loop.py, app/_health_monitor.py, app/_remediation.py, app/_state_authority.py, app/_overlay_manager.py, app/_game_lifecycle.py. Bridge tool set in tools/ (bridge_watcher_*, bridge_post_result.py, bridge_pull_tasks.py, RC-BridgeWatcher.xml) is also frozen. Scheduler auto-adds category 1 (hard gate) when a payload references any of these unless user_override=True.

decisions.title: ADR-008 unified asset-hash - no RC restart for asset-only edits
decisions.summary: Editing web/{js,css}/panels/* + data/ui_mock/*.json + web/data/* + dashboard/css/* triggers compute_asset_hash auto-reload. Browsers re-request on next dashboard load. No RC supervisor restart required for asset-only changes. Coach prompt edits + dashboard route module edits DO require a restart.

decisions.title: ADR-006 Riot API key policy - key permitted for champ-select + post-game
decisions.summary: Personal Riot API key permitted for champ-select context + post-game full-team enrichment. Key file at C:/Riot Commander/API-Key-Claude.txt (gitignored). Match-V5 403/empty on event modes (ARAM Mayhem KIWI, queue 2400, Arena) is EXPECTED not a key fault. UA-less requests = Cloudflare 1010. Key cache is process-lifetime.

decisions.title: DS conditional-target-state arc operator-CLOSED (s232)
decisions.summary: Daemon Slayer Part-2 live target-state plumbing is shelved permanently. An s232 saturation guard exists. Do NOT re-pitch Part-2 or re-scan for conditional candidates beyond the closed methodology. The block_index/form_index/max_priority/combo_sequence pure-data registries were swept s223-s232 and are provably saturated (machine-guarded). Further growth needs a schema lift, not uncovered-champion scans.

decisions.title: ASCII-only authored content - no em-dashes, en-dashes, or smart quotes
decisions.summary: Hard rule across Legion / Game-PC / Peer in ALL authored text: code, comments, docstrings, .md, writeups, commit messages, WAKEUP/ROADMAP/CLAUDE, bridge messages, chat output. Use ' - ' (spaced hyphen) for clause break, '-' otherwise. Avoid smart quotes (U+201C U+201D U+2018 U+2019) and en/em dashes (U+2013 U+2014). Stay ASCII. Root cause: Windows PowerShell 5.1 ParseFile ANSI-decodes no-BOM .ps1, turning UTF-8 em-dash in double-quoted strings into U+201D smart-quote that tokenizer treats as string terminator (2026-05-18 gamepc_boot.ps1 incident). Retroactive purge done 2026-05-18 via tools/strip_em_dashes.py; smart quotes rule-banned going forward but retro-sweep is separate operator-gated pass. The functional '-' no-data sentinel in code/JSON is operator-approved (empty cells render as '-').

decisions.title: Atomic writes only - tmp.write_text + tmp.replace pattern
decisions.summary: Any file write that other readers may poll mid-write MUST use the atomic dance: tmp = path.with_suffix(path.suffix + '.tmp'); tmp.write_text(...); tmp.replace(target). Overlays + dashboards poll JSON outputs mid-write so a partial write produces a parse error. Coaching JSONs, vision state, decisions_pending.json, health.json, peer_health, task_queue.jsonl compaction - all atomic.

decisions.title: Restart workflow - restart_trigger.txt, never Stop-Process
decisions.summary: RC restart via 'echo restart > restart_trigger.txt' (supervisor clears + restarts within ~5s). NEVER Stop-Process the supervisor or RC PID - hangs MCP pipe. Hard fallback: taskkill /F /PID <pid> then restart.bat. Verify via ops/runtime/health.json showing new pid, alive=true, last_reload_ok=true. The RC-Supervisor scheduled task can also be triggered via schtasks /Run /TN RC-Supervisor when restart_trigger is unavailable.

decisions.title: py_compile gate before every restart
decisions.summary: Always py_compile any modified .py file before triggering restart_trigger.txt. Syntax errors crash silently under pythonw.exe (no console). The supervisor's last_reload_ok=false latches and only schtasks /Run can recover. py_compile catches all SyntaxError + IndentationError + import-time NameError pre-restart.

decisions.title: SCRIPT_DIR layout - Path(__file__).parent.parent in app/__init__.py
decisions.summary: SCRIPT_DIR in app/__init__.py MUST be Path(__file__).parent.parent because the app/ package is one directory below the project root. Drift causes data/, logs/, ops/runtime/ paths to mis-resolve and the supervisor silently writes to the wrong tree. Frozen file - any change to app/__init__.py requires explicit user approval.

decisions.title: Phase 3 supervisor topology - WS_PORT 8891 + WEB_PORT 8890
decisions.summary: Two parallel supervisors run: ops/rc_supervisor.py (frozen, RC runtime supervisor) and agents/supervisor.py (Phase 3 framework, NOT frozen per s243, ports 8891 WS + 8890 web, proxied by /api/analyze). The RC :8888 dashboard runs in the rc_supervisor process; the Phase 3 framework is independent. RC-Phase3-Supervisor serves stale code - no restart_trigger equivalent; bounce via schtasks /End /TN RC-Phase3-Supervisor then /Run after editing the preflip-mirror chain or it broadcasts stale WS health.

decisions.title: Tailnet topology - 3 machines, prefer tailnet hostnames
decisions.summary: Legion (legion-rc / 100.70.22.55 / LAN 192.168.8.230) runs RC + supervisor + vision server + web dashboard. Game-PC (gamepc-rc / 100.95.66.128 / LAN 192.168.8.237) runs League + Chrome on secondary monitor (panel 1920x1280 native at 100% scale). Peer (peer-host / <peer-tailnet-ip>) is cross-Claude peer for RC<->Peer bridge. All three in tailnet tailc150de.ts.net. Prefer tailnet hostnames over LAN IPs (MagicDNS old hostname de-registers instantly on rename). Vision runs in-process at 127.0.0.1:8889.

decisions.title: Agent 6 auditor authority + scope
decisions.summary: Agent 6 (Opus 4.7, ephemeral) owns codebase health, perf, safeguards, scraper reweighting for Phase 3 framework. NOT responsible for coach output quality (Agent 4). Autonomous edits permitted on: lib/http/blocklist.json, agents/agent6_auditor/safeguards/*, agents/agent6_auditor/source_quality.json, rotating-log retention, firewall-adjacent ops/ scripts. Propose-and-queue for everything else via agents/agent6_auditor/proposals/<ts>-<label>/. NO cross-machine authority - never write to \\192.168.8.237\RCClient\*. Reads resolved_decisions.json as source of truth for locked decisions.

decisions.title: Game-end 0x50 BSOD root cause - DXGI screen-agent disabled
decisions.summary: Continuous DXGI screen-agent on Game-PC stays DISABLED at boot. Root cause traced to Duet (iPad) virtual-display + main-monitor resolution swap at match-end (1920x1080 -> 1440p) + GPU driver crash; vgk.sys is downstream symptom not root. On-demand mcp__gamepc__capture_monitor is the separate BSOD-clean path but stays operator-gated ('now' / 'got it'); re-confirm after Vanguard/League updates. Do NOT re-enable the continuous DXGI agent without a fix to the resolution-swap window.

decisions.title: Bridge mechanics - core.bridge.send() for outbound, asymmetric paths
decisions.summary: RC<->Peer bridge live over Tailscale since 2026-05-02; opt-in via cross_project: true in memory frontmatter. Outbound MUST use core.bridge.send() which routes ONLY to Peer. target=gamepc requires direct POST to Legion local /api/bridge with explicit id (Game-PC polls Legion, not vice versa). Bridge skill peer auto-invoke is unreliable - /process-bridge-tasks does not reliably auto-fire on Peer/Game-PC; manual 'see what is on the bridge' nudge is the recovery path.

decisions.title: Daemon Slayer engine version is authoritative via /health + current.txt
decisions.summary: Live DS truth = data/daemon_slayer/current.txt + agents/daemon_slayer/__init__.py ENGINE_VERSION + DS :8860 /health endpoint. Do NOT trust ledger recollection of patch/ENGINE. DS coverage %/match-row prose is a DS-batch docs-sync job, never recomputed in a general sync (nested registry schema; flat count mis-parses). After ENGINE_VERSION bump, DS server is NOT supervisor-watched; taskkill the pid + relaunch via schtasks /Run /TN RC-DaemonSlayer per reference_ds_server_not_supervisor_watched.

decisions.title: Keystone fix - ARAM Mayhem reports queueId 2400 (not 920)
decisions.summary: ARAM Mayhem queue ID is 2400 (KIWI gameMode), NOT 920 (legacy Poro King retired pre-s232). The phase-driven view-router is proven correct; cs.is_aram rendering path is item-87-preserved. The dead web/js/dashboard.js carries a stale 920 ref at dashboard.js:5055 (confirmed-dead legacy, leave it). The augment LCU/:2999 API is a confirmed dead-end (no capture-free augment API mid-game); augment-OCR into the coach is the proven path.

decisions.title: Arena queue ID is 1750 (CHERRY mapId 30) post-item-180
decisions.summary: Arena live queue = 1750 (CHERRY mapId 30); 1700/1710 both retired. Direct POST {queueId:1700} = 500 INVALID_LOBBY; {queueId:1750} = 200 OK. 1700/1710 retained as legacy classifier aliases in JS for rewind_history.db historical data only; lobby CREATE POSTs use 1750 exclusively. Practice Tool create body MUST carry explicit queueId:3140 in customGameLobby body. is_brawl: queue_id == 480 is permanently dropped (Brawl retired s214; 480 = Swiftplay in 16.10). Live LCU catalog at /lol-game-queues/v1/queues is the authoritative queue-ID source.

decisions.title: Dashboard UI sizing baseline - 1920x1080 Chrome windowed
decisions.summary: Authored at 1920x1080 Chrome windowed (usable viewport ~1920x920 with chrome chrome present). main flex-grows. No 100vh math. F11 fullscreen is optional and recovers chrome chrome - main flex-grows into the extra height (no layout pinned to 1280). Dashboard temp-relocated to monitor 1 for UI work was a TEMP 2026-05-10 measure - self-removing. Dashboard :8888 is HTTPS (self-signed); HTTP RSTs pre-Python and looks wedged.

decisions.title: Brawl mode retired from champ-select (s214)
decisions.summary: Brawl mode is retired from champ-select (s214); legacy brawl backend is left as deadcode for a separate cleanup pass. Do NOT re-enable Brawl in mode selectors or champion picker; queue 480 (which was Brawl) is now Swiftplay in 16.10 per live LCU catalog.

decisions.title: Phase 3 framework version pin - phase3-1.1
decisions.summary: EXPECTED_DECISIONS_VERSION in agents/_supervisor_common.py = 'phase3-1.1'. On supervisor startup _verify_decisions_version checks resolved_decisions.json version field matches this constant. Bump this constant whenever resolved_decisions.json version increments AND the code has been updated to honour the new contract. The version stamp + this constant gate any framework migration.

decisions.title: ADR-011 Legion 1-PC consolidation - Game-PC retired from pipeline
decisions.summary: Item 215 executed: Legion is the only runtime host. League + Vanguard + RC + supervisor + vision server + dashboard + OBS all on Legion. Game-PC retired from the live pipeline. RC_GAME_HOST defaults to 127.0.0.1; bridge no longer routes to gamepc-rc. Relocated agents (RC-LCUAgent, RC-LiveClientRelay, RC-HotkeyListener) run local as ONLOGON tasks on Legion. gamepc_*.py modules remain in tree for archival until Phase 11 relay collapse completes. Frozen-file list is unchanged. Do NOT re-pitch Game-PC as a live host.

decisions.title: 101.qq.com duo-synergy live-wired with kill switch (item 277)
decisions.summary: core/synergy_external_source.fetch_rows feeds existing core/smoothed_rates_101qq lane: live-first with static May-25 seed fallback. Endpoint faas-6831.native.qq.com getRankDouble (lane STRINGS, championid DDragon keys 1:1). 6h TTL, fail-soft, Referer-gated, never persisted to disk. Kill switch RC_DUO_SYNERGY_LIVE=0. /api/duo-synergy + bot/sup grid unchanged. Raw payload gitignored (redistributable). NOT geo-fenced, reachable from Legion, dynamic API (NOT static gtimg JSON). Do NOT re-pitch a static-only path or re-flag as geo-fenced.

decisions.title: DS live truth = data/daemon_slayer/current.txt + /health, NOT recomputed
decisions.summary: Daemon Slayer coverage %, match-row prose, patch, and ENGINE_VERSION must be read from data/daemon_slayer/current.txt + agents/daemon_slayer/__init__.py + DS :8860 /health. The registry is nested - a flat count mis-parses. DS coverage prose recompute is a DS-batch docs-sync job, never executed in a general sync. After ENGINE_VERSION bump DS is NOT supervisor-watched; taskkill the pid + relaunch via schtasks /Run /TN RC-DaemonSlayer. memory: feedback_ds_coverage_prose_recompute + reference_ds_server_not_supervisor_watched.

decisions.title: ADR-012 RC<->Peer cross-Claude bridge decommissioned
decisions.summary: Commit 49b1c9ea removed dashboard/routes_health_peer.py, the entire ops/runtime/peer_health/ folder, every bridge_watcher_*.py polling tool, and the core.bridge.send() outbound route. Charter line 'no cross-machine authority - never write to \\192.168.8.237\RCClient\*' still holds, but the rationale is now 'Game-PC + Peer peers no longer exist in the topology', not 'peer is read-only'. /api/health/all no longer carries a peers block; agent6 + supervisor + DS rollup remain. Peer is now only the separate private-project machine. Do NOT re-pitch a bridge or lessons-sync revival - operator-decided closure.

decisions.title: Overlay all-panels doctrine + click-through interactivity (ledger 644-648)
decisions.summary: rc-shell overlay: every panel individually accessible with per-panel opacity/scale; panel-set abstraction retired (commit b16bfce1). 3 panels stay interactive while playing via passive click-through zones (commit c79508d2). Draggable launcher widget acts as layout control center + the only in-game un-hide path (commit 6370f7da). Enemy summoner-spell MANUAL tap-tracker + API stats mini-panel landed (commit 5ff56099). In-game ACTIVE hotkey routes through tools/hotkey_listener.py WH_KEYBOARD_LL Win32 hook + signal file (Electron globalShortcut dead under League focus). A native-HUD replacement is impossible - Live Client :2999 exposes no ability/summoner cooldowns/buffs/wards/XP. Do NOT re-pitch a single-panel or panel-set design.

decisions.title: Game-PC SMB push deadcode pending cleanup pass (ADR-011/012)
decisions.summary: agents/agent2_backend/smb_push.py implemented the 2-PC Legion -> Game-PC file-write path over \\192.168.8.237\RCClient. Game-PC retired from the pipeline 2026-05-29 (ADR-011) and the RC<->Peer bridge was decommissioned 2026-06-24 (ADR-012), so the share has no receiving end. Path A (defer-delete, operator-decided 2026-06-28, mirror of d019 Brawl retirement): share_reachable() is hard-False and push()/trigger_forwarder_restart() raise a retired RuntimeError; the gatekeeper P-audit-h1 traversal guard in agents/agent0_gatekeeper/evaluator.py is KEPT as the standing safety net (it gates Task dataclasses, independent of smb_push). Agent 2/3/5/6 charters point at the Legion-local filesystem. A future quiescent-point cleanup pass may delete smb_push.py + the guard + charter lines in one swing. Do NOT re-wire a cross-machine push - there is no remote machine. Filed by audit-11 M-05.
